stem.text: Reduction of compound R with $\text{LiAlH}_4$ gives the compound 4-methylpentane-2,3-diol.
What could be the identity of compound R?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: two adjacent C=O groups and an isopropyl end.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: an aldehyde C=O at one end, a ketone C=O next to it, and an isopropyl end.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: two C=O groups separated by one carbon, with a methyl branch.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: an aldehyde C=O at one end, a methyl branch, and a ketone C=O next to an ethyl group.
